Ladakh Tourist Arrivals Surge, Nearing 2025 Levels by July 2026

Ladakh has recorded over 3.3 lakh tourist arrivals in the first seven months of 2026. This figure is approaching the total number of tourists who visited the region throughout the entire year of 2025. The data covers the period up to July 2026.
